_description: Focused dual-radio cross-preset bridge: a LONG_FAST radio (meshtasticd HAT, MQTT RX + HTTP TX) bridged to a SHORT_TURBO radio (USB serial, no second meshtasticd needed). rns_bridge_enabled=false makes this a pure cross-preset testbed that carries no RNS/NomadNet traffic — flip it true to compose with the LXMF bridge. The 'channels' allow-list is IMPORTANT on serial legs: serial RX hears every channel of its radio, so without it a secondary's ch0 text would re-TX on the primary's ch0 (possibly a public channel). The '[Mesh:' prefix is the echo-loop invariant — never remove or rename it (an untagged forward re-opens the cross-gateway echo-amplification loop).
_usage: cp mesh-bridge-dualradio.json ~/.config/meshforge/gateway.json && edit every <PLACEHOLDER>. The allow-listed channel indexes must carry the same channel (name + PSK) on BOTH radios. Then: sudo systemctl restart meshforge-gateway
_lab_note: injection_mode='downlink' (+ downlink_psk) on the primary leg is a LAB flag under canary soak — true-origin attribution on the primary radio's web UI. Default OFF here. See GATEWAY_BRIDGE_CONFIG_GUIDE.md §LAB before enabling.
